messages:
Maya: FYI prod SCIM sync started failing ~08:42 UTC, majority are 403s. Getting KMS decryption errors in our sidecar logs. Anyone touching key policies?

David: I see it too. Logs show KMS error: "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/prod-scim-key". This started right after the RBAC change for service-account-svc.

Nina: Can you paste the exact log snippet? Also, which principal is the SCIM service using?

David: Sure, pasted:```
2026-03-23T08:42:13Z scim-sidecar INFO request_id=abc123 action=sync start
2026-03-23T08:42:13Z scim-sidecar ERROR request_id=abc123 kms_error=AccessDeniedException Decrypt failed for key alias/prod-scim-key principal=arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/service-account-svc
2026-03-23T08:42:14Z scim-sidecar WARN request_id=abc123 provisioning_status=failed http_status=403
```

Maya: That principal was part of the RBAC cleanup rollout earlier. We removed a cross-account IAM role binding temporarily (PR #842). Could be related.

Ashley: I just checked CloudTrail — there are explicit KMS Deny events for that role after 08:40. Looks like there was a deny statement added to the key policy during the change.

Nina: If it's key-policy Deny then even if the role has IAM permission kms:Decrypt, the key policy deny will take precedence. We should revert the key policy change ASAP or add the role ARN back.

Maya: I can revert the key-policy patch now. Quick question: will that require a redeploy of the sidecar? Or will existing tokens pick up immediately?

David: Key policy changes are immediate. No redeploy required for KMS itself, but the sidecar caches DEKs in memory. If there were failures during initial decrypt, sidecar might have failed to bootstrap and needs a restart.

Ashley: Reverting now. Patch ID: keypolicy-2026-03-23-08:39 reverted. Confirmed via console: key policy no longer has Deny for role/service-account-svc.

saml-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0323-17. Assigned to eng-security.

David: Restarting scim-sidecar pods in prod. `kubectl -n scim rollout restart deploy/scim-sidecar`

Maya: pods restarted, watching logs.

David: First pod logs show successful decrypt and SCIM sync resumes: `provisioned=12 users synced` :tada:

Nina: Nice. Root cause: key policy deny introduced as collateral during RBAC cleanup PR. Action items: 1) Add key-policy check to RBAC change checklist, 2) Add an automated CloudTrail alert for KMS Deny events for prod keys, 3) Postmortem doc.

Ashley: On vuln triage: the RBAC PR also removed an unused AWS principal which we thought low-risk. We'll include a small audit of all affected policies to ensure no broad denies slipped in.

Maya: I'll draft the postmortem and assign owners. Adding alert: cloudwatch -> pagerduty for KMS Deny on prod keys.

David: Closing the incident in 15m if no regressions. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Maya: Follow-up note: PR link and rollback summary in INC ticket. Will loop legal for audit trail retention per compliance.

saml-bot: INC-2026-0323-17 status -> resolved by Maya (08:59 UTC).
